children: While consumer staples are generally associated with defensive demand, agricultural products and food distribution companies remain exposed to commodity cycles, input costs and changing supply-chain conditions.

Against this backdrop, only three consumer staples stocks in the list have maintained a Strong Buy Quant Rating for at least 60 consecutive days. The qualifying names come from the agricultural products and services and food distribution industries, highlighting a relatively small group of companies with sustained quantitative strength within these subsectors.
leads the list, having maintained a Strong Buy Quant Rating for 199 consecutive days. Archer-Daniels-Midland Company
follows with 140 consecutive days, while The Chefs' Warehouse, Inc.
rounds out the three-stock list with 63 consecutive days.

DAR and ADM provide exposure to agricultural products and services, while CHEF operates in food distribution. The three companies therefore represent different points across the food and agricultural supply chain, while all have maintained the Strong Buy designation for at least two months.

Seeking Alpha's Quant Ratings system grades stocks on their relative performance on key quantitative metrics. It hones in on stocks with the strongest combination of value, growth, profitability, EPS revisions and price momentum relative to their sector peers.
